end.summary:
Practised plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Built and read simple food chains; 2 of 3 attempts were unaided correct.
Predicted that removing one living thing can affect the chain.
Arrow direction was mixed up: they said it points from the eater to its food; this was not corrected later.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying what animals eat and building food chains with arrows. The arrow direction was still mixed up; at home, practise saying “the arrow points from the food to the eater” while drawing one short chain.
